correctness.rationale: Sano Theorem 1.1 plus Proposition 3.4 and Corollary 5.4 exhaust all CM-PCF parameters. For d≥3 each pairwise difference among the at most three forward orbit entries is a unit (c, (1+ω)c, ωc), so no reduction can identify them. For d=2, c=0,-1 are trivial; c=-2 has differences with 2-adic valuations 1,1,2; c=±i has only nonunit differences c−1, 2c, 2c−1 with Gaussian valuations at (1+i) and (2c−1) of 1,2,1. Checking exact first repeats gives all local types. The CRT identity (max of preperiods, least common multiple of periods) eliminates all other whole-ideal exceptions. All calculations are explicit in RESULT.md; 1078 local, 484 composite, 9438 prime-field examples independently checked by check_portraits.py. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The all-ideal critical-orbit degeneration spectrum for every CM-PCF unicritical polynomial, including exact dyadic intermediate types and the composite-ideal restoration phenomenon, is absent from the inspected closest primary classifications and distinct from more general liftability or good-reduction theorems. Searches for equivalent, stronger, and special-case coverage in published published-finding corpus records and source literature did not disclose a covering theorem; residual unindexed coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed dynamical-arithmetic studies or standard computations may already list the same all-ideal critical portraits, notwithstanding the lack of a found matching record.
The Anderson–Manes–Tobin article was assessed from accessible abstract and open journal text snippets rather than a complete publisher or arXiv full text; its object differs materially.
The published published-finding corpus related studies were indexed summaries only, not full scientific packages; the scientific comparison rests on their stated different objects.
The all-degree premise relies on the 2026 Sano theorem, not an independent reproof of the global CM classification.

value.rationale: The degeneration of a marked PCF critical orbit is a natural arithmetic invariant distinct from good reduction of the polynomial map. The result completes its behavior over every integral ideal for the complete CM-PCF unicritical locus, uniformly in unbounded degree and arbitrary residue characteristic. Exact intermediate portraits modulo the first two dyadic layers and the precise Gaussian norm-five exception mark mathematically meaningful boundaries; the CRT restoration for mixed exceptional ideals is a structural conclusion. The claim neither asserts an arbitrary finite slice nor a cosmetic restatement of the characteristic-zero classification.
